paragraphs: R. Natan bar Minyomi: R. Kahana says R. Natan bar Minyomi expounded two matters in R. Tanḥum's name, Shabbat 21a,b; Ḥagigah 3a; Bava Kamma 62b. Rav's student—I did not find it.
